capabilities.title: Neural task JSON media type and request-size boundary
targetEnvironments: Cloudflare Worker runtime after reviewed rollout

evidence.targetEnvironment: Branch test harness; CI pending for this change

limitations: Do not treat this capability as verified until the branch CI completes successfully.
No production configuration or deployment is performed by this change.

capabilities.title: Exact-host egress allowlists for backend and Neural APIs
capabilities.boundary: Cloudflare Worker outbound requests to the configured backend and GLORIFIER-NEURAL origins
targetEnvironments: Mocked Worker unit tests; deploy-time configuration review required

evidence.notes: The Worker requires an independently configured exact-host allowlist for the configured backend and Neural origin, rejects missing/mismatched host lists, uses HTTPS origin validation and manual redirect handling, and bounds upstream requests.

evidence.targetEnvironment: Mocked Worker unit test harness; CI run pending for the latest branch commit
evidence.notes: Regression tests reject missing or mismatched allowlists and assert backend redirects are requested in manual mode.

limitations: This capability remains NOT VERIFIED until the new test suite passes on the proposed branch.

Before any reviewed rollout, an owner must configure exact hostnames matching the reviewed GLORIFIER_BACKEND_ORIGIN and GLORIFIER_NEURAL_ORIGIN; no secrets or production configuration are written by this PR.
A hostname allowlist is not evidence that the target service is reachable or healthy.
